title: readtimetable
summary: Read tabular data into a timetable.

gpu_support.notes: File import runs on the host.

description: `readtimetable(filename, ...)` imports column-oriented file data and designates the first datetime or duration variable as the timetable row times.
behaviors: Text and spreadsheet options accepted by `readtable` are forwarded, including exact native integer variable types and the documented all-eight-class `VariableNamesLine` control.
Typed-integer values for otherwise floating-only import controls are RunMat-only extensions and are rejected in MATLAB compatibility mode before gathering or file access.

The public contract infers row times from the first imported datetime or duration variable. RunMat extension mode additionally accepts a numeric `RowTimes` column and preserves native integer values exactly.
If no datetime or duration variable exists, sequential numeric row times are generated only in RunMat extension mode; MATLAB-compatible mode reports the missing time source.

examples.description: Reading A Timetable From A File
examples.output: TT = timetable object using the first datetime or duration column as row times
TT = timetable with an exact uint64 data variable
